Why: this is set by how a function is called, not where it was defined. Called on its own, greet gets this = undefined (class code is strict), so this.name throws. call() passes this for one call; bind() makes a copy with this fixed.

Docs: MDN — Function.prototype.bind() — https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Function/bind
quote: The bind() method of Function instances creates a new function that, when called, calls this function with its this keyword set to the provided value, and a given sequence of arguments preceding any provided when the new function is called.
